newsitem.title: USA: Rexworks says still cautious on '97 sales.
newsitem.headline: Rexworks says still cautious on '97 sales.

text.p: Rexworks Inc, which provides cement mixers and landfill compactors and grinders, said Monday it remains cautious about sales prospects for 1997.
"We continue to see mixer and compaction customers delay purchasing decisions," Laurance Newman, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
"We remain cautious with regard to sales prospects for the balance of 1997," Newman said. "We continue to focus on cost control so we can remain profitable despite reduced customer demand."
Earlier, Rexworks reported first quarter earnings of $0.02 a share versus $0.10 a share last year.

The company noted the results were an improvement over third and fourth quarters 1996 when it reported losses. It said grinder sales were improved in 1997 versus last year, and the new Biogrind and Megagrind products are receiving favorable market response.
First quarter sales were nine percent lower versus 1996, while selling, general and administrative expenses were 17 percent lower.
"Because of this reduction in spending, we were able to report a small profit," Newman said.
